description: This file defines a Flutter widget called CategoryItem, which represents an individual category option in a food ordering app. The widget displays a text label and an optional underline indicator if the category is active. It handles tap events via a callback function.

classes.name: CategoryItem
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a category item with a title and active state, which can detect tap events and visually indicate whether it is active.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, including text and optional underline, based on the active state.
